question: Which of the following Indian Classical dancers was the youngest to receive the Padma Vibhushan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Padma Vibhushan is the second highest civilian award of India.
 
• It is second only to the Bharat Ratna. 
 
• The first recipients of the award (in 1954) were - __
 
 
• *Satyendra Nath Bose*, *Nand Lal Bose*, *Zakir Hussain*, *Balasaheb Gangadhar Kher*, *Jigme Dorji Wangchuck*, and *V. K. Krishna Menon*.
